sections.title: About Cockpit
sections.intro: Cockpit is an aircraft's instrument panel: a matte black dial in a crinkle bezel with four screws, luminous drum counters in recessed windows, caption lights such as a lit green ON, and a clock on a riveted plate.

items.alt: The Cockpit style, as the wallpaper draws it
items.caption: Cockpit, drawn by the app itself

items.title: €2.39, once
items.text: Buy Cockpit once on Google Play and it's yours. On a new phone with the same Google account, it comes back by itself.

items.title: One dial, three jobs
items.text: The big gauge shows power, CPU clock or GPS speed. Tap it on your home screen to switch, as in every style.

items.title: Make it yours
items.text: Customize sets Cockpit's colours and background, and its units, clock and warning lights.

items.title: Layouts, and your own
items.text: Most styles come in several layouts. You can also drag and resize the gauges and save your own.

sections.title: Layouts made with Cockpit
sections.intro: Drivers built these layouts in Cockpit and shared them in the app's layout market, most used first. Every layout works in every style.

sections.title: More styles
sections.intro: Every style runs live on its own page. Or try them all in your browser.

image.alt: The Harbour style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Harbour
items.text: Marine instruments: brass rope-edge bezels around navy enamel on a teak deck, a gold needle and brass-framed counters.

image.alt: The Track Night style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Track Night
items.text: A race screen: a rev ladder, the value huge on an electric-blue band, and shift lights closing in from both sides.

image.alt: The Torque style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Torque
items.text: A muscle-car dash: a curved rev arc with a red shift zone, a big round dial on gunmetal, the time as a framed gear number, and fuel and temperature arcs.

image.alt: The Circuit style, as the wallpaper draws it

items.title: Circuit
items.text: The track look: glowing blue sweeps on deep black, three small round gauges between the rev arc and the dial, and crisp thin digits.
